native_contract.object: Existing ObjectsFem.makeMaterialSolid / MaterialCommon, not a custom writer or analysis adapter
native_contract.modulus_storage: Native App::PropertyPressure, displayed as MPa in the task panel; explicit GPa-to-MPa export conversion covered. Zero defaults deliberately require user-supplied values.
native_contract.poisson_convention: nu_ij = -strain_j/strain_i under uniaxial stress_i; reciprocal nu_ji/E_j=nu_ij/E_i. Verified against official CalculiX2.23 elastics.f and real nonzero-Poisson patches.
native_contract.frame: Native MaterialOrientation rotation relative to global mesh axes, or MaterialOrientationReference's placement composed through native parent geometry groups. Reference is App::PropertyLinkGlobal, including nested datum/placed object and App::Link occurrence; translation is ignored.
native_contract.region_assignment: Existing material References and actual material element sets. Different regions/axes use separate native material objects, which may share the same material card.
native_contract.legacy_region_rule: A sole material applies to the whole mesh; existing References are ignored in that case. Use multiple materials for region ownership. This inherited rule is explicit in the new GUI tooltip, not claimed fixed.
native_contract.persistence: Legacy documents gain Isotropic-default fields without replacing their cards; native constants, orientation/reference links and region references persist.
native_contract.gui: Material task panel adds Elasticity and material axes form with model selector, nine constants, local axis/angle and placed-reference chooser. Inputs are staged until Accept, shared validation keeps invalid dialogs open, Cancel preserves native values, and card changes do not overwrite directional data. Untouched values keep full native precision despite rounded widget display.

export_contract.elastic: *ELASTIC, TYPE=ENGINEERING CONSTANTS: E1,E2,E3,nu12,nu13,nu23,G12,G13 on first line; G23 on second line, MPa/dimensionless
export_contract.orientation: *ORIENTATION, NAME=ORIENT_<material-object-name> with material unit-X and unit-Y in global coordinates, plus matching ORIENTATION assignment on each actual solid/shell section. Long names have stable collision-resistant80-character bounds.
export_contract.validation: Finite positive E/G, finite ratios, positive-definite reciprocal compliance before and after standard13G serialization, valid placed reference, and explicit unsupported-context rejection.
export_contract.supported_scope: Linear orthotropic engineering-constant elasticity for3D solid elements and ordinary3D shells, including the documented shell-plane projection of material directions. Uses CalculiX's elastic law, not a new constitutive engine.
export_contract.unsupported_scope: No beam/truss, fluid,2D/membrane, composite layup, or isotropic-plasticity combination on an orthotropic material. No timber/plywood damage/failure or large-strain material-law qualification.
export_contract.other_exporters: Z88/Mystran and Elmer elasticity/deformation explicitly reject the native Orthotropic selector before isotropic fallback. Unrelated thermal-only Elmer use is not blocked by this mechanical guard.
